title: no_trainer_digest
description: The facts the message kind no_trainer_digest (daily reminder: requests still waiting for a trainer) can use. A fact schema is the one definition of what a template of this kind may mention: the Console offers exactly these as placeholders and the checker refuses any other. Facts marked x_derived are worked out by the kind's fact builder in the product, not typed by anyone and not computed by the template.

x_kind.name: Requests waiting for a trainer (daily reminder)
triggers: The daily 8:00 Mountain scheduled job, or Send reminders now in the Console (super admin and admin): sent to the same people as the urgent notice, each told only about requests in their own territory. Nothing is sent to a person when nothing in their territory is waiting.
x_kind.recipient: adhoc: the Google email and name on each access person. The wording carries towns, states and counts only, so one copy is safe for every recipient including the Global Inspector.
x_kind.dedupe: explicit key: kind + access person id + the day; a hand send (Send reminders now) bypasses it
refs: none: the digest covers several requests, so it links to no single record.

name.description: How the email greets the person: the first word of their name, else the word there.

count.description: How many requests are still waiting for a trainer in this person's territory, as a number in words of digits.

places.description: Where they are, the towns with the number waiting in each, most first. Towns and states only, no names or contacts.

oldest_days.description: How many whole days the longest-waiting request has been waiting.

console_url.description: The address of the Console. Public; never carries a key or a token.
